tasks.title: Lecture #16
tasks.instruction: Listen to a short talk on biology.
tasks.transcript: Now the Australia jumping spider as you can image got its name for its ability to leap. But it can swim too. What’s most interesting though is its ability to use try and error tactics when solving problems. Now the jumping spider attacks and eats other spiders. It’ll sit at the edge of another spider's web and attract the spider by tapping out different signals to mimic the struggles of a trapped insect and it’ll keep changing the signals till successfully lured its prey out. Well, to see if the jumping spider could apply the same problem solving technique, try and error to unfamiliar situations, scientists conducted an experiment. They field a trap full of water and then put some sand in the middle, like an island. In between the island and the edge of the trap, they put a rock. When they put the spider on the island, some tried jumping to the rock, and some tried swimming. All the spiders that successfully reached the rock either by jumping or by swimming use the same method to make it from the rock to the edge of the tree. If the spider failed to reach the rock, it was placed back on the island, but the next time they try to leave, spiders did opposite of whatever didn’t work the first time, leaping if it had swum, or swimming if it had leaped. So we see the spiders using the same try and error in crossing the water as they used in hunting.

questions.stem: What this talk on Australia jumping spiders mainly about?
questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：这段关于澳大利亚跳蛛的讲话主要讲了什么？ 定位原文： What’s most interesting though is its ability to use try and error tactics when solving problems. ... Well, to see if the jumping spider could apply the same problem solving technique, try and error to unfamiliar situations, scientists conducted an experiment. 选项分析： A. How they swim long distances（它们如何长距离游泳）。讲话提到跳蛛会游泳，但这只是实验中的一个细节，并非主要内容，所以A选项错误。 B. How they got their name（它们如何得名）。讲话开篇提到其名字源于跳跃能力，但这只是引入，并非主题，所以B选项错误。 C. How they hunt（它们如何捕猎）。讲话描述了跳蛛捕猎时使用试错策略，但这是为了引出其在解决问题方面的能力，并非主要内容，所以C选项错误。 D. How they solve problems（它们如何解决问题）。讲话重点介绍了跳蛛在捕猎和实验中都运用试错策略解决问题，因此D选项正确。

questions.stem: According to the talk, how does the Australia spiders attract the other kinds of spiders?

options.B: By imitating signals that the other spiders send.
options.D: By imitating insects caught in a web.

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：根据谈话内容，澳大利亚跳蛛如何吸引其他种类的蜘蛛？ 定位原文：It'll sit at the edge of another spider's web and attract the spider by tapping out different signals to mimic the struggles of a trapped insect and it'll keep changing the signals till successfully lured its prey out. 选项分析： A. 通过改变外观。文本中没有提到改变外观，因此A选项错误。 B. 通过模仿其他蜘蛛发出的信号。跳蛛模仿的是被困昆虫的挣扎，而非其他蜘蛛的信号，因此B选项错误。 C. 通过织一张大网。跳蛛是坐落在其他蜘蛛的网边，并未自己织网，因此C选项错误。 D. 通过模仿被困在网中的昆虫。原文明确指出跳蛛通过敲击发出信号，模仿被困昆虫的挣扎，从而引诱猎物出来，因此D选项正确。

questions.stem: In the experiment, what did the spiders have to do to reach the rock?

options.C: Jump to the edge of the tray.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：在实验中，蜘蛛为了到达岩石必须做什么？ 定位原文： They field a trap full of water and then put some sand in the middle, like an island. In between the island and the edge of the trap, they put a rock. When they put the spider on the island, some tried jumping to the rock, and some tried swimming. 选项分析： A. Avoid attacks by other spiders（躲避其他蜘蛛的攻击）。基于实验环境中未涉及其他蜘蛛，所以A选项错误。 B. Cross some water（穿过一些水）。讲话描述陷阱中装满了水，蜘蛛在岛上，岩石在水中，因此必须穿过水才能到达岩石，所以B选项正确。 C. Jump to the edge of the tray（跳到托盘的边缘）。讲话中蜘蛛的目标是先到达岩石，再到达边缘，所以C选项错误。 D. Spin a long thread（吐出一根长丝）。基于讲话未提及蜘蛛吐丝，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: what would happen if the spider tied to get to the rock but fail to reach the rock?

options.A: It would keep trying to reach the rock the same way.
options.B: It would try to reach the rock a different way.
options.C: The scientists would move the spider to the rock.
options.D: The scientists would place another spider in the tray.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：如果蜘蛛试图到达岩石但未能成功，会发生什么？ 定位原文： If the spider failed to reach the rock, it was placed back on the island, but the next time they try to leave, spiders did opposite of whatever didn’t work the first time, leaping if it had swum, or swimming if it had leaped. 选项分析： A. It would keep trying to reach the rock the same way（它会用同样的方式继续尝试到达岩石）。讲话明确指出蜘蛛会改变方式，所以A选项错误。 B. It would try to reach the rock a different way（它会尝试用不同的方式到达岩石）。讲话说明蜘蛛在第一次失败后，下次会采取相反的方式，因此B选项正确。 C. The scientists would move the spider to the rock（科学家会把蜘蛛移到岩石上）。讲话提到科学家将蜘蛛放回岛上，而非移到岩石上，所以C选项错误。 D. The scientists would place another spider in the tray（科学家会在托盘里放入另一只蜘蛛）。基于讲话未提及放入其他蜘蛛，所以D选项错误
